question: Should OpenClaw add public persisted rootSessionKey and session-chain traceId fields for spawned sessions, and should traceId be a new chain identifier or bridge to existing diagnostic trace context?
rationale: The code change is bounded, but it creates durable persisted session and Gateway/tool API fields whose semantics must be stable before another fix PR is useful.

options.title: Add Minimal Spawn-Chain Contract
options.body: Add optional parent/root/trace/depth metadata for spawned sessions only, with additive schema, projections, docs, and tests while leaving traversal APIs for later.

options.title: Align With Broader Lineage First
options.body: Keep this open until session-family and sessions.resolve lineage semantics settle, then align spawned-session metadata with that broader contract.

options.title: Reject Durable Root/Trace Fields
options.body: Keep current parent/depth behavior and limit future work to tooling or docs if maintainers do not want a new persisted chain identifier.

recommendation.title: Add Minimal Spawn-Chain Contract
recommendation.body: Add optional parent/root/trace/depth metadata for spawned sessions only, with additive schema, projections, docs, and tests while leaving traversal APIs for later.

likelyOwner.reason: He already triaged this issue around the same missing public contract and is the best available owner for the API-direction decision.
